Benefit1Sub: Textiles that adapt to your home
Benefit1Detail:
We believe: textiles should adapt to your home, not the other way around. Every table, every window, and every terrace has its own characteristics. That's why we've moved away from mass standards in favor of personalization.

Custom-made products: From small napkins to luxurious tablecloths for non-standard tables.

Attention to detail: We help you select the shape, color, and finish (for example, delicate ruffles or lace) that will perfectly complement your specific interior.
Benefit2Sub: Aesthetics That Aren't Afraid of Life
Benefit2Detail:
Your textiles should stay flawless not only on holidays but also during daily family breakfasts. We choose fabrics that combine classic beauty with modern technology.

Water-repellent properties: A special impregnation allows you to simply wipe away spilled liquid with a napkin, keeping the fabric clean.

Durability: Our materials are wear-resistant, pleasant to the touch, and maintain color richness even after many care cycles.
Benefit3Sub: Quality control at every stage of sewing
Benefit3Detail: Our own workshop allows us to control the quality of every stitch and guarantee the exact deadlines for your order.
FooterAbout: Casanel custom sewing workshop. We create coziness and comfort in your home.
About_Title: Textile Art with Soul and 15 Years of Experience
About_Intro: The story of the Casanel brand is a journey from the idea of a cozy home to professional textile production, where every product has its own character
About_Roots_1: The brand was founded in 2021, but a new stage of its life began in 2023, when Casanel passed into the hands of a person for whom sewing is a calling.
About_Roots_2: I am Oksana, the current owner of the brand, and my journey in the world of professional sewing began back in 2011. For over 10 years, I created complex individual orders, studying the intricacies of working with various fabrics and shapes.
About_Craft_1: Today, Casanel is a combination of years of experience and a modern take on home comfort. When I took over the brand, my main goal was to preserve the traditions of quality and introduce a professional approach to every detail.
Personal Control: I personally control every stage of creating your orders:
Fabric_Desc: we choose only those materials that last for years (in particular, our famous water-repellent canvases).
Cut_Desc: thanks to experience in individual sewing, we create products that fit perfectly on your furniture.
Detail_Desc: every stitch is the result of craftsmanship honed over the years.
Mission_Text_New: We don’t just sew tablecloths or pillows. We create an atmosphere you want to return to. Today, Casanel is a small but ambitious Ukrainian production. Each of your orders helps us develop and bring our dream closer: to make Ukrainian textiles recognizable and loved in every home.
About_Closing: By choosing Casanel, you choose experience tested by time and quality created with love

Offer_Subtitle: Public offer agreement of the Casanel.com.ua online store
Offer_1_1: This offer is an official proposal by Individual Entrepreneur Oksana Vasylivna Basarab, hereinafter referred to as the "Seller", to enter into a Sales Agreement for goods by distance means through the Casanel.com.ua online store, hereinafter referred to as the "Website".
Offer_1_2: The Buyer's full and unconditional acceptance of the Seller's proposal to enter into an electronic sales agreement is deemed to be the fact of the Buyer paying for an order under the terms of this Agreement, within the time frame and at the prices specified on the Seller's Website.
Offer_2_0: In this offer, the following terms have the meaning given below:
Offer_2_Product: home, kitchen, and outdoor textile products, as well as textiles for windows and furniture, presented in the "Catalog" section of the Casanel.com.ua Website.
Offer_2_Store: a means of presenting or selling goods through an electronic transaction via the Casanel.com.ua website.
Offer_2_Buyer: an individual who has entered into the Agreement with the Seller.
Offer_2_Order: a selection of specific product items indicated by the Buyer when placing an order and making payment.
Offer_3_1: The Seller undertakes to transfer ownership of the Product to the Buyer, and the Buyer undertakes to pay for and accept the Product under the terms of this Agreement. This Agreement governs the sale and purchase of goods in the Online Store, including the voluntary selection of products, independent order placement, payment, processing, and delivery.
Offer_4_1: The Buyer has the right to place an order for any Product presented on the Website.
Offer_4_2_intro: Products on the website fall into two categories:
Offer_4_2_a: finished items available in the Seller's stock.
Offer_4_2_b: items manufactured to the Buyer's individual order (to their own dimensions, design, configuration, etc.).
Offer_4_3: When placing an order for a made-to-order Product, or if a Product is not currently in stock, the Seller (or a manager) agrees with the Buyer on manufacturing timelines and other details (by phone, messenger, or email).
Offer_4_4: The Buyer has the right to confirm the order under the agreed terms or cancel it before production of the item begins or it is shipped.
Offer_5_1: Payments for goods are made in the national currency of Ukraine — hryvnia.
Offer_5_2: In-stock Products (finished items) are paid for on the basis of 100% prepayment to the Sole Proprietor's current account (IBAN) specified on the Website.
Offer_5_3_intro: Made-to-order Products (to individual sizes or specifications) are paid for, at the Buyer's choice, in one of the following ways:
Offer_5_3_a: 100% prepayment to the Sole Proprietor's current account (IBAN);
Offer_5_3_b: a partial prepayment of 50% of the order value to the Sole Proprietor's current account (IBAN), with the remaining amount paid as cash on delivery (COD) upon receiving the order at a Nova Poshta branch.
Offer_5_4: An order is considered accepted for production and confirmed only after the funds (full payment or the agreed 50% prepayment) have been credited to the Seller's account.
Offer_5_5: If funds are not received, the Seller has the right to cancel the order.
Offer_6_1: Goods purchased in the Online Store are delivered via postal operators (e.g., "Nova Poshta") throughout the territory of Ukraine (excluding temporarily occupied territories and active combat zones).
Offer_6_2_intro: At the Buyer's choice, delivery may be made:
Offer_6_2_c: as courier delivery by the postal operator to the Buyer's door.
Offer_6_3: The cost and timing of delivery are calculated and paid separately by the Buyer according to the tariffs of the chosen carrier, unless otherwise agreed when placing the order.
Offer_6_4: The Buyer is provided with documents in accordance with the legislation of Ukraine together with the order.
Offer_S7_Title: 7. Rights and Obligations of the Parties
Offer_7_1: The Seller has the right to unilaterally cease providing services if the Buyer violates the terms of this agreement.
Offer_7_2: The Buyer is obliged to pay for and receive the order in a timely manner.
Offer_7_3: The Buyer has the right to place an order and require the Seller to fulfill the terms of this Agreement.
Offer_8_1: The parties are liable for failure to perform or improper performance of the terms of this agreement in the manner provided for by this agreement and the current legislation of Ukraine.
Offer_8_2_intro: The Seller is not liable for:
Offer_8_2_a: minor discrepancies in the Product's color, which may differ from the original solely due to differences in color reproduction of the Buyer's monitor or mobile device screen;
Offer_8_2_b: inaccuracies in dimensions or details arising from the Buyer providing inaccurate or incorrect measurements for a custom order;
Offer_8_2_c: the content and accuracy of information provided by the Buyer when placing an order;
Offer_8_2_d: delays, disruptions, or damage to the Product during delivery caused by the postal operator (carrier);
Offer_8_2_e: unlawful or illegal actions committed by the Buyer while using the Internet.
Offer_8_3: The Buyer is solely responsible for the accuracy of the data provided when placing an order.
Offer_8_4: In the event of force majeure circumstances, the parties are released from fulfilling the terms of this agreement for the duration of such circumstances.
Offer_8_5: The parties shall endeavor to resolve any disputes and disagreements exclusively through negotiation.
Offer_9_1: The Online Store reserves the right to unilaterally amend this agreement, with publication on the Casanel.com.ua website.
Offer_9_2: By accepting this offer, the Buyer consents to the collection and processing of their personal data in accordance with the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection".
Offer_9_3: Information provided by the Buyer is confidential and used solely for the purpose of fulfilling the order.
Offer_10_1: In accordance with the Law of Ukraine "On Consumer Rights Protection", customers of the Casanel.com.ua online store have the right to exchange or return finished standard products (purchased from stock) within 14 days of receiving them.
Offer_10_2_intro: Under Article 9 of the Law of Ukraine "On Consumer Rights Protection", only new, unused products with no signs of use (stains, wear, foreign odors, etc.) are subject to exchange or return. The following must also be preserved:
Offer_10_2_a: the complete set of the product;
Offer_10_2_b: the integrity of the original packaging, brand labels, and tags;
Offer_10_2_c: the receipt or a document confirming the purchase.
Offer_10_3: In accordance with Annex No. 3 to Resolution No. 172 of the Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine dated March 19, 1994, "On the Implementation of Certain Provisions of the Law of Ukraine 'On Consumer Rights Protection'", products manufactured to the Buyer's individual order (to their own dimensions, specifications, or design) are not subject to return or exchange, as they have individually defined characteristics.
Offer_10_4_a: Before shipping the product, the Buyer must contact the Seller's manager and agree on the reason and method of shipment.
Offer_10_4_b: The product is returned via a postal operator ("Nova Poshta") to the Seller's address in Dnipro (the branch number is confirmed with the manager when arranging the return).
Offer_10_4_c: The parcel with the product must include: a written statement addressed to Individual Entrepreneur Oksana Vasylivna Basarab specifying your requirements; the product itself, complete and in its original packaging with tags; the sales receipt.
Offer_10_4_d: The cost of return shipping for a product of proper quality is borne by the Buyer.
Offer_10_5: If the quality of the product needs to be verified (for example, if a manufacturing defect or a discrepancy in specifications is discovered), an inspection may be carried out, the duration of which, in accordance with Clause 6, Article 8 of the Law of Ukraine "On Consumer Rights Protection", is up to 14 days. If a defect is confirmed, the cost of delivery and the refund are covered by the Seller.
Offer_10_6: When refunding money for a product, settlements with the buyer are made based on the value of the product at the time of purchase. The money is returned to the buyer's bank account on the day the corresponding request is made, or, if this is not possible on that day, at another time agreed upon by the parties, but no later than within 7 days.
Offer_11_1: The electronic agreement is considered concluded from the moment the proposal is accepted.
Offer_11_2: The Agreement may be terminated by mutual consent of the parties before the product is shipped.
Offer_11_3: The parties have the right to terminate the agreement unilaterally in cases provided for by law.
Delivery_Subtitle: Delivery terms for orders within Ukraine and abroad, and how payment works
Delivery_Ukraine_Intro: We deliver orders within Ukraine via Nova Poshta and Ukrposhta.
NP_Item_1: We send orders to a branch, parcel locker, or directly to your address.
NP_Item_2: Delivery usually takes 2–3 business days from the moment the order is shipped.
NP_Item_3: In some cases delivery may take longer due to logistics network load, weather conditions, air raid alerts, or other circumstances affecting the postal operator's work.
NP_Item_4: Delivery cost is paid by the buyer according to Nova Poshta's current rates.
NP_Item_5: Once the order is shipped, we'll provide a tracking number for the parcel.
UP_Item_1: We send orders to a branch or directly to your address.
UP_Item_2: Delivery time depends on the destination and the shipping method chosen.
UP_Item_3: Delivery cost follows Ukrposhta's current rates and is paid by the buyer.
UP_Item_4: Once the order is shipped, we'll provide you with a tracking number for the parcel.
Delivery_Prepaid_Notice: if an order was prepaid, it can only be picked up by the person listed as the recipient.
Intl_Item_1: International orders are sent via Ukrposhta.
Intl_Item_2: Cost and delivery time depend on the destination country, weight, and size of the order. Delivery cost is calculated according to Ukrposhta's current rates and is paid by the buyer.
Intl_Item_3: Once the order is shipped, you'll receive a tracking number for the parcel.
Intl_Item_4: International delivery time may vary depending on the postal, customs, and other services of the destination country.
Intl_Item_5: If an order is refused for reasons other than a manufacturing defect or a mistake on our part, the cost of return shipping is covered by the buyer.
Receiving_Item_1: Please check the parcel when you receive it.
Receiving_Item_2: If the packaging is damaged or you notice damage to the product, we recommend recording this immediately together with a representative of the postal operator and contacting us.
Receiving_Item_3: We are not responsible for delivery delays caused by the postal operator, but we're always ready to help resolve any issue.
